controls.label: PIONIER reconstruction
controls.notes: An image of the photosphere reconstructed by the public SQUEEZE code from the public VLTI/PIONIER visibilities and closure phases of four nights in September 2014, in the H band (1.62-1.73 micrometres), convolved to the 2.1 milliarcsecond interferometric beam and cast onto a sphere of the fitted radius, so nothing finer than the beam is shown. The star has no measured rotation axis: the axis shown is celestial north, a display convention. The far hemisphere is unobserved and carries the no-data grid.
